## Motivation

tokio-tungstenite had a new (breaking) release, 0.25/0.26 that finally allows sending shared data over websockets, and it would be cool if this new breaking change could get in axum 0.8.0 given it's a new major release
<!--
Explain the context and why you're making that change. What is the problem
you're trying to solve? If a new feature is being added, describe the intended
use case that feature fulfills.
-->

## Solution

the websocket extract has been changed, and it now exposes  `Bytes` and `Utf8Bytes` (UTF-8 wrapper around `Bytes`)
<!--
Summarize the solution and provide any necessary context needed to understand
the code change.
-->

comments.body: Return a vec here no longer makes sense, upstream has `fn into_data(self) -> Payload`.
Return a `String` here no longer makes sense, upstream has `fn into_text(self) -> Result<Utf8Payload>`.
This example could use a static payload, something like using upstream `Utf8Payload::from_static("Username already taken.")`
This use case could show the shared bytes reuse.

```suggestion
            Self::Close(None) => Ok(Utf8Bytes::from_static("")),
```
Or if you derive `Default` for `Utf8Bytes` (as upstream does):
```suggestion
            Self::Close(None) => Ok(<_>::default()),
```

This check is done by the upstream TryFrom impl

```suggestion
```

It might be worth also adding similar methods `Message::text`, `Message::binary` as upstream to make code like this a little nicer. As a mixed user of axum & tungstenite you maybe would expect them to be available in both.
This could probably be left as a follow up task, if so maybe just add a TODO here?
An issue usually works better than a fixme comment for stuff like this. Feel free to open one.
Not sure how to word this, but "stringable" is not a word in my vocabulary :D
